notes.title: TRANSFORMERS: BATTLEGROUNDS - Complete Edition
notes.content:
The complete edition of[b] TRANSFORMERS: BATTLEGROUNDS[/b] is now out, including all previous DLC packs and the multi-dimensional story adventure 'Shattered Spacebridge' in one full package.

[b]Complete Edition[/b] includes:
[list]
[*] TRANSFORMERS: BATTLEGROUNDS
[*] Gold Autobot Skin Pack
[*] Energon Autobot Skin Pack
[*] Battle Autobot Skin Pack
[*] Neon Autobot Skin Pack
[*] Nemesis Prime & Goldfire Bumblebee Skin Pack
[*] CUBE Game - Arcade Add-on
[*] TRANSFORMERS: BATTLEGROUNDS – SHATTERED SPACEBRIDGE
[i]Help the Autobots rebuild the Spacebridge back to Cybertron - all while battling the evil Decepticons - in a multi-dimensional adventure with countless paths home![/i]
[/list]
We hope you enjoy this definitive edition!

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.content:
- Fixed passive Wheeljack VO playing over some loading screens.
- Fixed some issues with Korean Language Setting.
- Fixed a bug which displayed unpurchaseable owned Abilities in Wheeljack's Lab.

notes.title: Hotfix for DLC owners (Including Deluxe Edition)
notes.content:
An update (r15767) for TRANSFORMERS: BATTLEGROUNDS has been released. The fixes affect access to purchasable DLC including:

[list]
[*] Purchased Skins are now selectable in the SELECT YOUR SQUAD screen for [i]all[/i] players who have either purchased Skin packs separately or own the Deluxe Edition.
[*] CUBE game is now selectable in Arcade Mode for [i]all[/i] players who have purchased the Deluxe Edition.
[/list]

We are sorry to all players who have been inconvenienced, thank you for your patience!
